title: 橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗
summary: 從 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋的扭轉顫振崩塌出發，建立橋面設計風速、氣動現象分類、斷面外形與扭轉勁度、Scruton 數等結構參數，再處理施工懸臂階段的抗風、節段模型的彈簧懸吊試驗與縮尺換算、全橋氣動彈性模型、營運期渦振與阻尼器改善以及改裝前的風洞複核，並以明石海峽大橋的全橋模型風洞試驗與伏爾加格勒大橋 2010 年振動事件為例。
summaryEn: Starting from the torsional flutter collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940, establish deck design wind speed, the classes of aeroelastic phenomena, section shape and torsional stiffness and structural parameters such as the Scruton number, then cover wind resistance during cantilever erection, spring-mounted section-model tests and scaling, full aeroelastic models, in-service vortex vibration and damper retrofits and aerodynamic rechecks before modifications, using the full-model wind-tunnel tests of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge and the 2010 vibration event on the Volgograd Bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某斜張橋主梁寬 B = 32 m、深 D = 3.5 m，扭轉頻率 f_t = 0.35 Hz、豎向頻率 f_b = 0.12 Hz、每延公尺質量 18,000 kg/m、對數衰減率 0.03。基本風速 40 m/s、橋面高 70 m，取 α = 0.125：U_d = 40×7^0.125 ≈ 51.0 m/s，顫振需求取 1.2 倍約 61.2 m/s。1/50 節段模型、頻率比 f_m/f_p = 5，速度縮尺 (1/50)×5 = 0.1。原斷面在模型 5.6 m/s 發生顫振，對應原型 56 m/s，折減風速 56/(0.35×32) = 5.0，小於 61.2 m/s，不合格；加裝整流罩後折減風速提升到 6.5，原型顫振風速 6.5×0.35×32 ≈ 72.8 m/s，滿足需求。渦振方面，St = 0.11 時豎向渦振臨界風速 U_cr = 0.12×3.5/0.11 ≈ 3.8 m/s，Sc = 2×18,000×0.03/(1.25×3.5²) ≈ 70.5；若完工實測阻尼只有一半，Sc 約 35，渦振振幅約加倍，需預留阻尼器空間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的試驗結果。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a cable-stayed girder is B = 32 m wide and D = 3.5 m deep, with torsional frequency f_t = 0.35 Hz, vertical frequency f_b = 0.12 Hz, 18,000 kg/m mass and a logarithmic decrement of 0.03. With a 40 m/s basic speed, a 70 m deck height and α = 0.125, U_d = 40×7^0.125 ≈ 51.0 m/s, and the flutter requirement at 1.2 times is about 61.2 m/s. A 1/50 section model with frequency ratio f_m/f_p = 5 has velocity scale (1/50)×5 = 0.1. The original section flutters at 5.6 m/s in the model, 56 m/s at full scale, a reduced velocity of 56/(0.35×32) = 5.0, below 61.2 m/s, so it fails; adding fairings raises the reduced velocity to 6.5, giving a full-scale flutter speed of 6.5×0.35×32 ≈ 72.8 m/s, which meets the requirement. For vortex shedding with St = 0.11 the vertical onset speed is U_cr = 0.12×3.5/0.11 ≈ 3.8 m/s and Sc = 2×18,000×0.03/(1.25×3.5²) ≈ 70.5; if as-built damping is only half, Sc is about 35 and vortex amplitude roughly doubles, so space for dampers should be reserved. Values are teaching assumptions, not test results for any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設計風速與風場特性」與「渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics" and "Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面高度設計風速」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck-level design wind speed” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。海峽與河口地形開闊、粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加較慢但基本值高；山谷地形則可能產生局部加速與強烈紊流。除平均風速外，還要給出紊流強度與積分尺度，因為它們決定了陣風抖振的大小，也影響模型試驗中紊流場的重現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面高度設計風速」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness. Open straits and estuaries have low roughness, so speed grows slowly with height but the base value is high; valleys can produce local speed-up and strong turbulence. Besides mean speed, turbulence intensity and integral length scales must be specified, because they control buffeting response and must be reproduced in model tests. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck-level design wind speed” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面高度設計風速」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck-level design wind speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面高度設計風速」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck-level design wind speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。若基本風速 46 m/s、橋面高約 97 m、取 α = 1/8（教學假設），U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s，與明石海峽大橋公開的加勁梁設計風速 60 m/s 相近；若 α 改為 1/6，同高度風速約 67 m/s。數值除註明者外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. With a basic wind speed of 46 m/s, a deck about 97 m above the sea and α = 1/8 as a teaching assumption, U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s, close to the published 60 m/s girder design wind speed of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge; with α = 1/6 the speed at the same height is about 67 m/s. Values other than those cited are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。若基本風速 46 m/s、橋面高約 97 m、取 α = 1/8（教學假設），U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s，與明石海峽大橋公開的加勁梁設計風速 60 m/s 相近；若 α 改為 1/6，同高度風速約 67 m/s。數值除註明者外為教學假設。

With a basic wind speed of 46 m/s, a deck about 97 m above the sea and α = 1/8 as a teaching assumption, U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s, close to the published 60 m/s girder design wind speed of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge; with α = 1/6 the speed at the same height is about 67 m/s. Values other than those cited are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「設計風速與風場特性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面高度設計風速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck-level design wind speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風工程報告的第一章要列出基本風速、回歸期、地況分類、橋面與塔頂設計風速、紊流強度與積分尺度，並說明資料來源；後續所有試驗與分析都引用同一組參數，變更時須全面更新。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The first chapter of the wind-engineering report lists basic speed, return period, terrain category, deck and tower-top design speeds, turbulence intensity and integral scales with their sources; every later test and analysis cites the same set, and any change triggers a full update.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。
knowledge.textEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風工程報告的第一章要列出基本風速、回歸期、地況分類、橋面與塔頂設計風速、紊流強度與積分尺度，並說明資料來源；後續所有試驗與分析都引用同一組參數，變更時須全面更新。
knowledge.textEn: The first chapter of the wind-engineering report lists basic speed, return period, terrain category, deck and tower-top design speeds, turbulence intensity and integral scales with their sources; every later test and analysis cites the same set, and any change triggers a full update.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設計風速與風場特性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics"?
options: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。
optionsEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.instruction: 以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 風對長跨橋面造成四類動力問題：渦流脫落在特定風速鎖定結構頻率，引起有限振幅的渦振，常在低風速出現而影響舒適與疲勞；馳振是鈍形斷面在單一方向的自激振動，振幅隨風速無限增長；顫振是彎曲與扭轉耦合（或純扭轉）的自激振動，一旦超過臨界風速，氣動力持續輸入能量而發散；抖振則是紊流造成的隨機強迫振動，不會發散但控制強度與疲勞。風洞試驗要分別找出前三者的發生風速，並量測抖振的反應大小。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wind causes four classes of dynamic problems on long-span decks: vortex shedding locks onto a structural frequency at particular speeds and causes limited-amplitude vortex-induced vibration, often at low speed and affecting comfort and fatigue; galloping is a single-direction self-excited motion of bluff sections whose amplitude grows without limit with speed; flutter is self-excited coupled bending–torsion or pure torsion that diverges beyond a critical speed as the airflow keeps feeding energy; buffeting is random forced vibration from turbulence that does not diverge but governs strength and fatigue. Wind-tunnel tests must find the onset speeds of the first three and measure buffeting response. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：渦振臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vortex-shedding onset U_cr = f·D/St. With deck depth D = 4 m, vertical frequency f = 0.15 Hz and St = 0.10: U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s, a common wind speed, so vibration will occur frequently; a more streamlined section with St = 0.20 gives U_cr = 3.0 m/s but usually less energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：渦振臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。梁深 D = 4 m、豎向頻率 f = 0.15 Hz、St = 0.10：U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s，屬常見風速，振動會頻繁發生；若改為 St = 0.20 的較流線斷面，U_cr 降為 3.0 m/s，但能量通常較小。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vortex-shedding onset U_cr = f·D/St. With deck depth D = 4 m, vertical frequency f = 0.15 Hz and St = 0.10: U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s, a common wind speed, so vibration will occur frequently; a more streamlined section with St = 0.20 gives U_cr = 3.0 m/s but usually less energy. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在節段模型試驗中由低至高逐級提高風速，記錄每一風速的豎向與扭轉振幅，畫出振幅—風速曲線，辨識渦振鎖定區、馳振或顫振的起始風速，並以不同攻角（例如 −3°、0°、+3°）重複，找出最不利情況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In section-model tests raise wind speed step by step, record vertical and torsional amplitude at each step and plot amplitude against speed to identify lock-in ranges and the onset of galloping or flutter, repeating at several angles of attack such as −3°, 0° and +3° to find the worst case.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 在節段模型試驗中由低至高逐級提高風速，記錄每一風速的豎向與扭轉振幅，畫出振幅—風速曲線，辨識渦振鎖定區、馳振或顫振的起始風速，並以不同攻角（例如 −3°、0°、+3°）重複，找出最不利情況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In section-model tests raise wind speed step by step, record vertical and torsional amplitude at each step and plot amplitude against speed to identify lock-in ranges and the onset of galloping or flutter, repeating at several angles of attack such as −3°, 0° and +3° to find the worst case. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計審查要求風工程報告分別列出渦振、馳振、顫振的檢核結果與抖振反應，並說明每一項採用的允收準則；任何一項無法以計算確認時，必須以風洞試驗驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design review requires the wind report to list results for vortex shedding, galloping and flutter and the buffeting response separately, with the acceptance criterion for each; any item that cannot be confirmed by calculation must be verified by wind-tunnel test.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：1940 年 11 月 7 日，主跨約 853 m、以 8 呎深板梁為加勁梁的塔科馬海峽橋，在約 40 mph（64 km/h）的風中發生扭轉振動，振幅不斷增大直到吊索斷裂、橋面墜落；這不是靜力風壓過大，而是氣動自激振動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: On 7 November 1940 the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted in a wind of about 40 mph (64 km/h) with growing amplitude until suspenders broke and the deck fell; the cause was aeroelastic self-excitation, not excessive static wind pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 橋面斷面外形與扭轉勁度：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「斷面外形與扭轉常數 J」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section shape and torsion constant J” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋面斷面決定了氣流如何分離與再附著：寬而淺、兩端尖削的流線箱梁能讓氣流平順通過，顫振臨界風速高；開口板梁或鈍形斷面則在前緣強烈分離，容易產生渦流與扭轉自激。塔科馬海峽橋寬約 39 呎、梁深 8 呎，寬深比低又是開口斷面，扭轉勁度極小。改善方法包括閉合箱梁、加導流板（整流罩）、中央開槽或格柵，以及加深的桁架加勁梁；閉合斷面的扭轉勁度遠高於開口斷面，使扭轉頻率與彎曲頻率分開，提升顫振風速。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斷面外形與扭轉常數 J」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The deck section governs how flow separates and reattaches: a wide, shallow streamlined box with tapered edges lets air pass smoothly and has a high flutter speed, while an open plate-girder or bluff section separates strongly at the leading edge and readily sheds vortices and self-excites in torsion. The Tacoma Narrows deck was about 39 ft wide and 8 ft deep, a low width-to-depth ratio on an open section with tiny torsional stiffness. Remedies include closed boxes, fairings, central slots or gratings and deeper truss stiffening girders; a closed section is far stiffer in torsion than an open one, separating torsional from bending frequency and raising flutter speed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Section shape and torsion constant J” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Closed box J = 4A²/∮(ds/t): for 30 m×3 m with 14 mm equivalent plate, A = 90 m² and ∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714, so J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴; an open twin-girder section of the same size has J = Σbt³/3 = (2×3×0.02³ + 30×0.014³)/3 ≈ 4.3×10⁻⁵ m⁴, about 158,000 times smaller.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋面斷面只影響外觀與交通，風洞試驗只需要看主梁本體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Closed box J = 4A²/∮(ds/t): for 30 m×3 m with 14 mm equivalent plate, A = 90 m² and ∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714, so J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴; an open twin-girder section of the same size has J = Σbt³/3 = (2×3×0.02³ + 30×0.014³)/3 ≈ 4.3×10⁻⁵ m⁴, about 158,000 times smaller. steps.title: 質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mass, damping and the Scruton number: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「質量阻尼參數 Sc」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scruton number Sc” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 同一個斷面外形，振動大小還取決於結構本身的質量與阻尼：每延公尺質量越大、阻尼越高，風輸入的能量越難把結構推動。Scruton 數把質量、對數衰減率與空氣密度、斷面深度合成一個無因次參數，渦振振幅大致隨 Scruton 數增加而減小。鋼橋的結構阻尼通常很低，混凝土橋較高；施工中或完工後的實際阻尼常與設計假設不同，因此試驗時要以合理偏低的阻尼檢核，並在完工後實測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「質量阻尼參數 Sc」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a given section shape, response size also depends on the structure's mass and damping: the greater the mass per metre and the higher the damping, the harder it is for wind energy to drive the structure. The Scruton number combines mass, logarithmic decrement, air density and section depth into one dimensionless parameter, and vortex amplitude falls roughly as it rises. Steel bridges usually have very low structural damping and concrete bridges more; actual damping during and after construction often differs from design assumptions, so tests use a reasonably low damping value and damping is measured after completion. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Scruton number Sc” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「質量阻尼參數 Sc」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mass, damping and the Scruton number: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「質量阻尼參數 Sc」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scruton number Sc” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²)。m = 20,000 kg/m、δ = 0.03、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³、D = 4 m：Sc = 2×20,000×0.03/(1.25×16) = 60；若實際對數衰減率只有 0.015，Sc 降為 30，渦振振幅約加倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²). With m = 20,000 kg/m, δ = 0.03, ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ and D = 4 m: Sc = 2×20,000×0.03/(1.25×16) = 60; if the actual logarithmic decrement is only 0.015, Sc falls to 30 and vortex amplitude roughly doubles. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：節段模型的質量、質量慣性矩與阻尼要依縮尺換算並量測確認（以自由衰減求模型阻尼）；完工後以環境振動或強迫振動實測橋梁的頻率與阻尼，與試驗假設比較，若阻尼明顯偏低則重新評估渦振振幅。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The section model's mass, mass moment of inertia and damping are scaled and measured (model damping from free decay); after completion, measure the bridge's frequencies and damping by ambient or forced vibration and compare with test assumptions, re-evaluating vortex amplitudes if damping is clearly lower.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: The wind report states the damping used and its basis and gives amplitude sensitivity to damping; the contract reserves post-completion damping measurement and the space and provisions to add dampers if needed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗時採用偏高的阻尼，報告結論為渦振振幅可接受；完工後鋼橋實際阻尼只有一半，在每天常見的風速下出現明顯上下振動，行車舒適度與構件疲勞都成為問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using optimistic damping in tests leads to a report that vortex amplitudes are acceptable; after completion the steel bridge has only half that damping and shows obvious vertical motion in everyday winds, creating ride-comfort and fatigue problems. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: The section model's mass, mass moment of inertia and damping are scaled and measured (model damping from free decay); after completion, measure the bridge's frequencies and damping by ambient or forced vibration and compare with test assumptions, re-evaluating vortex amplitudes if damping is clearly lower.

quiz.question: 要驗證「質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mass, damping and the Scruton number"?
options: 節段模型的質量、質量慣性矩與阻尼要依縮尺換算並量測確認（以自由衰減求模型阻尼）。

optionsEn: The section model's mass, mass moment of inertia and damping are scaled and measured (model damping from free decay).
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record.

steps.title: 質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mass, damping and the Scruton number: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「質量阻尼參數 Sc」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scruton number Sc” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試驗時採用偏高的阻尼，報告結論為渦振振幅可接受；完工後鋼橋實際阻尼只有一半，在每天常見的風速下出現明顯上下振動，行車舒適度與構件疲勞都成為問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using optimistic damping in tests leads to a report that vortex amplitudes are acceptable; after completion the steel bridge has only half that damping and shows obvious vertical motion in everyday winds, creating ride-comfort and fatigue problems. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼橋的結構阻尼通常很低，混凝土橋較高；施工中或完工後的實際阻尼常與設計假設不同，因此試驗時要以合理偏低的阻尼檢核，並在完工後實測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Steel bridges usually have very low structural damping and concrete bridges more; actual damping during and after construction often differs from design assumptions, so tests use a reasonably low damping value and damping is measured after completion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mass, damping and the Scruton number" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
試驗時採用偏高的阻尼，報告結論為渦振振幅可接受；完工後鋼橋實際阻尼只有一半，在每天常見的風速下出現明顯上下振動，行車舒適度與構件疲勞都成為問題。
施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using optimistic damping in tests leads to a report that vortex amplitudes are acceptable.
Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工階段的氣動穩定」與「施工期抗風措施與作業風速」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Aerodynamic stability during erection" and "Erection-stage wind measures and working limits": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工階段的氣動穩定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic stability during erection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「最大懸臂階段」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Longest cantilever stage” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋梁在施工中往往比完工後更怕風：斜張橋單側或雙側懸臂伸出時，沒有另一端的支撐，彎曲與扭轉頻率都比完工狀態低；懸索橋在加勁梁分段吊裝、接頭尚未全部鎖固時，扭轉勁度特別小。施工階段的風速檢核可以採用較短的回歸期，但因為頻率降低、阻尼不確定，渦振與顫振的臨界風速可能落入常見範圍。因此風洞試驗必須涵蓋關鍵施工階段，而不只是完工狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「最大懸臂階段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bridges are often more vulnerable to wind during construction than when complete: a cable-stayed cantilever reaching out on one or both sides has no support at its far end, so bending and torsional frequencies are lower than in the finished state; a suspension bridge whose deck segments are being lifted with joints not yet locked has particularly low torsional stiffness. Construction-stage wind checks may use a shorter return period, but with reduced frequencies and uncertain damping the vortex and flutter onset speeds can fall into the common range. Wind-tunnel tests must therefore cover the critical construction stages, not only the completed state. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Longest cantilever stage” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cantilever frequency varies roughly as 1/L².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「最大懸臂階段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Longest cantilever stage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工階段的氣動穩定
knowledge.text: 橋梁在施工中往往比完工後更怕風：斜張橋單側或雙側懸臂伸出時，沒有另一端的支撐，彎曲與扭轉頻率都比完工狀態低；懸索橋在加勁梁分段吊裝、接頭尚未全部鎖固時，扭轉勁度特別小。施工階段的風速檢核可以採用較短的回歸期，但因為頻率降低、阻尼不確定，渦振與顫振的臨界風速可能落入常見範圍。

Construction-stage wind checks may use a shorter return period, but with reduced frequencies and uncertain damping the vortex and flutter onset speeds can fall into the common range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工階段的氣動穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Aerodynamic stability during erection" is correct?
options: 施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。
懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。
橋梁在施工中往往比完工後更怕風：斜張橋單側或雙側懸臂伸出時，沒有另一端的支撐，彎曲與扭轉頻率都比完工狀態低。
optionsEn: Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test.
As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工階段的氣動穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic stability during erection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「最大懸臂階段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Longest cantilever stage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。最大懸臂由 150 m 增為 200 m，頻率降為 (150/200)² ≈ 0.56 倍：扭轉頻率 0.60 Hz 降為約 0.34 Hz，渦振臨界風速由 6.0 m/s 降為約 3.4 m/s，顫振風速亦隨扭轉頻率約按比例下降。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cantilever frequency varies roughly as 1/L². Growing the longest cantilever from 150 m to 200 m multiplies frequency by (150/200)² ≈ 0.56: a 0.60 Hz torsional frequency falls to about 0.34 Hz, the vortex onset speed from 6.0 to about 3.4 m/s, and flutter speed drops roughly in proportion to torsional frequency. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析找出頻率最低、最不利的幾個階段，製作對應的節段或全橋施工模型試驗；檢核採用的回歸期與風速要經業主核定，並與施工期程中的颱風季節對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use staged analysis to find the lowest-frequency, most critical stages and test the corresponding section or full-bridge erection models; the return period and wind speed used must be approved by the owner and compared with typhoon seasons in the construction schedule.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Growing the longest cantilever from 150 m to 200 m multiplies frequency by (150/200)² ≈ 0.56: a 0.60 Hz torsional frequency falls to about 0.34 Hz, the vortex onset speed from 6.0 to about 3.4 m/s, and flutter speed drops roughly in proportion to torsional frequency. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「施工階段的氣動穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Aerodynamic stability during erection", which statement holds?
options: 懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。
節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。

quiz.explanation: 懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cantilever frequency varies roughly as 1/L². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Longest cantilever stage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析找出頻率最低、最不利的幾個階段，製作對應的節段或全橋施工模型試驗；檢核採用的回歸期與風速要經業主核定，並與施工期程中的颱風季節對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 施工期抗風措施與作業風速：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary stays and lifting wind limits” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 施工期的抗風措施分為結構與作業兩類：結構措施包括臨時穩定索把懸臂端拉到地面或墩上、臨時支墩縮短懸臂長度、在懸臂端加裝臨時調諧質量阻尼器，以及調整吊裝順序讓扭轉勁度較早形成；作業措施則是以現地風速計即時監控，超過門檻時停止吊裝、鎖固吊具與梁段。懸臂越長，橫向風力在塔或墩底產生的彎矩越大，臨時措施也要能承受颱風等級的風力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「臨時穩定索與吊裝風速」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Erection-stage wind measures are structural and operational. The longer the cantilever, the larger the moment that lateral wind creates at the pylon or pier base, and temporary measures must also resist typhoon-level wind. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary stays and lifting wind limits” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 施工期抗風措施與作業風速：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臨時穩定索與吊裝風速」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橫向風力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L。U = 25 m/s、C_D = 1.2、D = 4 m、L = 200 m：F = 0.5×1.25×625×1.2×4×200 = 375,000 N = 375 kN；作用於懸臂中點，塔底附加彎矩 375 kN×100 m = 37.5 MN·m；風速加倍為 50 m/s 時增為 4 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在塔頂與懸臂端設置風速計並與吊裝控制室連線，記錄 10 分鐘平均與陣風；臨時穩定索的張力以荷重計監測，颱風前後比對；臨時阻尼器安裝後以自由衰減試驗確認懸臂阻尼提升。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install anemometers at the pylon top and cantilever tip linked to the lifting control room, recording 10-minute means and gusts; monitor temporary-stay tension with load cells before and after typhoons; after fitting a temporary damper, confirm the cantilever's added damping by a free-decay test.

steps.instruction: 吊裝作業只依天氣預報而未以現地風速計判斷，梁段在吊起後遇到陣風擺動撞擊已完成段；颱風前未完成臨時穩定索張拉，懸臂端在強風中大幅振動，損壞接頭與吊具。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」與「全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spring-mounted section-model testing" and "Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Spring-mounted section-model testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節段模型速度縮尺」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section-model velocity scale” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 節段模型是把橋面一段做成剛性縮尺模型（常見 1/40 至 1/80），以彈簧懸吊在風洞中，使其具有與原型對應的豎向與扭轉頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼。相似的關鍵是折減風速 U/(f·B) 相同，因此可以自由選擇模型頻率，再由頻率比與長度縮尺換算風速縮尺。試驗可直接觀察渦振與顫振，也可量測靜力係數與顫振導數，供全橋顫振與抖振分析使用；塔科馬海峽橋崩塌前，Farquharson 已在華盛頓大學以 1/20 節段模型與 1/200 全橋模型進行研究。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節段模型速度縮尺」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A section model reproduces a length of deck as a rigid scaled model, commonly 1/40 to 1/80, mounted on springs in the tunnel so its vertical and torsional frequencies, mass, inertia and damping correspond to the prototype. The key similarity is equal reduced velocity U/(f·B), so the model frequency can be chosen freely and the velocity scale follows from the frequency ratio and length scale. Tests observe vortex shedding and flutter directly and measure static coefficients and flutter derivatives for full-bridge flutter and buffeting analysis; before the Tacoma Narrows collapse, Farquharson at the University of Washington was already studying a 1:20 section model and a 1:200 full model. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Section-model velocity scale” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「節段模型速度縮尺」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Section-model velocity scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗
knowledge.text: 節段模型是把橋面一段做成剛性縮尺模型（常見 1/40 至 1/80），以彈簧懸吊在風洞中，使其具有與原型對應的豎向與扭轉頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼。相似的關鍵是折減風速 U/(f·B) 相同，因此可以自由選擇模型頻率，再由頻率比與長度縮尺換算風速縮尺。

quiz.question: 關於「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spring-mounted section-model testing" is correct?

steps.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spring-mounted section-model testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節段模型速度縮尺」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Section-model velocity scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。長度縮尺 1/60，原型寬 35 m 對應模型 0.583 m；原型扭轉頻率 0.30 Hz、模型 2.0 Hz，λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111。模型在 7.0 m/s 發生顫振，對應原型 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s，即折減風速 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p). At a 1/60 length scale a 35 m prototype width becomes 0.583 m; with prototype torsional frequency 0.30 Hz and model frequency 2.0 Hz, λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111. Flutter at 7.0 m/s in the model corresponds to 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s at full scale, a reduced velocity of 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗前量測模型的頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼並與目標比較；試驗中以均勻流與紊流各做一組、多個攻角，記錄振幅—風速曲線；將換算的顫振風速與規範要求（設計風速乘以安全係數）比較，並重複試驗確認再現性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before testing measure model frequency, mass, inertia and damping against targets; test in smooth and turbulent flow at several angles of attack, recording amplitude against speed; compare the converted flutter speed with the code requirement (design speed times a safety factor) and repeat to confirm reproducibility.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。長度縮尺 1/60，原型寬 35 m 對應模型 0.583 m；原型扭轉頻率 0.30 Hz、模型 2.0 Hz，λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111。模型在 7.0 m/s 發生顫振，對應原型 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s，即折減風速 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p). At a 1/60 length scale a 35 m prototype width becomes 0.583 m; with prototype torsional frequency 0.30 Hz and model frequency 2.0 Hz, λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111. Flutter at 7.0 m/s in the model corresponds to 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s at full scale, a reduced velocity of 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spring-mounted section-model testing", which statement holds?
options: 加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。
只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。
速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。
optionsEn: Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability.
If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it.
Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p).

steps.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spring-mounted section-model testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節段模型速度縮尺」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section-model velocity scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗前量測模型的頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼並與目標比較；試驗中以均勻流與紊流各做一組、多個攻角，記錄振幅—風速曲線；將換算的顫振風速與規範要求（設計風速乘以安全係數）比較，並重複試驗確認再現性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before testing measure model frequency, mass, inertia and damping against targets; test in smooth and turbulent flow at several angles of attack, recording amplitude against speed; compare the converted flutter speed with the code requirement (design speed times a safety factor) and repeat to confirm reproducibility. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗計畫要列出長度、頻率、速度、質量與阻尼的縮尺關係與允差，試驗報告附原始資料、攻角與流場條件；顫振檢核以最不利攻角的結果為準，並由獨立風工程師審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The test plan lists scale relations and tolerances for length, frequency, velocity, mass and damping, and the report attaches raw data, attack angles and flow conditions; flutter checks use the worst angle, reviewed by an independent wind engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative; testing only at 0° attack while ignoring terrain-induced updraft or downdraft can miss the worst flutter speed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節段模型速度縮尺」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section-model velocity scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative; testing only at 0° attack while ignoring terrain-induced updraft or downdraft can miss the worst flutter speed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗可直接觀察渦振與顫振，也可量測靜力係數與顫振導數，供全橋顫振與抖振分析使用；塔科馬海峽橋崩塌前，Farquharson 已在華盛頓大學以 1/20 節段模型與 1/200 全橋模型進行研究。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spring-mounted section-model testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。

Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative.

steps.title: 全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「全橋氣動彈性模型」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full aeroelastic model” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 節段模型假設氣流沿橋軸二維、振型均勻，無法反映懸索與斜張橋的三維振型、主纜與吊索的重力勁度、斜風與塔的互制以及紊流的空間相關性。全橋氣動彈性模型以 Froude 相似律縮放（使重力勁度正確），在大型邊界層風洞中重現紊流風場，直接觀察整座橋在不同風向下的反應。明石海峽大橋（主跨 1,991 m，1988 至 1998 年建造）即以全橋模型風洞試驗驗證其抗風性能，加勁梁設計風速為 60 m/s、橋塔為 67 m/s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「全橋氣動彈性模型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Section models assume two-dimensional flow along the deck and a uniform mode shape, so they cannot capture the three-dimensional modes of suspension and cable-stayed bridges, the gravity stiffness of cables and hangers, skewed wind and tower interaction or the spatial correlation of turbulence. A full aeroelastic model is scaled by Froude similitude so that gravity stiffness is correct and tested in a large boundary-layer tunnel that reproduces turbulent wind, directly observing the whole bridge's response at different wind directions. The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge (main span 1,991 m, built 1988 to 1998) was verified by full-model wind-tunnel testing, with design wind speeds of 60 m/s for the stiffening girder and 67 m/s for the towers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Full aeroelastic model” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Froude 相似：速度縮尺 λ_U = √λ_L、時間縮尺 √λ_L、頻率縮尺 1/√λ_L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Froude similitude: velocity scale λ_U = √λ_L, time scale √λ_L and frequency scale 1/√λ_L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「全橋氣動彈性模型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Full aeroelastic model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「全橋氣動彈性模型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full aeroelastic model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Froude 相似：速度縮尺 λ_U = √λ_L、時間縮尺 √λ_L、頻率縮尺 1/√λ_L。λ_L = 1/100 時 λ_U = 0.1：原型 60 m/s 對應模型 6 m/s；原型頻率 0.15 Hz 對應模型 1.5 Hz；模型 1 分鐘記錄相當原型 10 分鐘。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Froude similitude: velocity scale λ_U = √λ_L, time scale √λ_L and frequency scale 1/√λ_L. At λ_L = 1/100, λ_U = 0.1: 60 m/s at full scale is 6 m/s in the model, a 0.15 Hz prototype frequency is 1.5 Hz in the model and 1 minute of model record equals 10 minutes at full scale. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對全橋模型的模態頻率與振型和有限元素分析；以熱線或多孔探針量測風洞紊流強度與頻譜，與目標風場比較；把全橋模型的反應與以節段模型顫振導數計算的全橋分析結果相互驗證，差異需能解釋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the full model's modal frequencies and shapes with finite-element results; measure tunnel turbulence intensity and spectra with hot-wire or multi-hole probes against the target wind field; cross-check full-model response against full-bridge analysis using section-model flutter derivatives, with differences explained.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

The deck section affects only appearance and traffic, so tests need only the bare girder.

steps.title: 全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「全橋氣動彈性模型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full aeroelastic model” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對全橋模型的模態頻率與振型和有限元素分析；以熱線或多孔探針量測風洞紊流強度與頻譜，與目標風場比較；把全橋模型的反應與以節段模型顫振導數計算的全橋分析結果相互驗證，差異需能解釋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the full model's modal frequencies and shapes with finite-element results; measure tunnel turbulence intensity and spectra with hot-wire or multi-hole probes against the target wind field; cross-check full-model response against full-bridge analysis using section-model flutter derivatives, with differences explained. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：主跨超過一定規模或形式特殊的橋梁，業主應在設計階段就安排全橋模型試驗的時程與經費；全橋試驗報告要列出模型縮尺、風場量測、各風向的反應與和分析的比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For bridges beyond a certain span or of unusual form, the owner schedules and funds full-model testing from the design stage; the report lists model scales, wind-field measurements, responses by wind direction and comparison with analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：全橋模型的主纜或吊索勁度未依 Froude 律縮放，重力勁度失真，量到的扭轉頻率與振型錯誤；風洞紊流太弱則低估抖振反應，使塔與加勁梁的設計彎矩偏小。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If cable or hanger stiffness in a full model is not scaled by Froude's law, gravity stiffness is distorted and measured torsional frequencies and mode shapes are wrong; tunnel turbulence that is too weak underestimates buffeting and leaves tower and girder design moments too low. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「營運期風振觀測與改善」與「改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies" and "Change control, closure wind speeds and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「營運期渦振與阻尼器」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 風洞試驗不能保證完工後絕不振動：實際阻尼、附屬物、臨時設施或風場都可能與試驗不同。2010 年 5 月俄羅斯伏爾加格勒大橋在強風中出現明顯振動，當局在 5 月 20 日封閉全部車流、5 月 25 日重新開放，之後由 MAURER 與瑞士 Empa 等合作開發半主動調諧質量阻尼器，於 2011 年秋季安裝 12 組、每組質量 5,200 kg。營運期的改善手段包括加裝阻尼器、導流板或整流罩，以及移除改變氣流的附屬物，但每一項都要先以監測資料確認振動型態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「營運期渦振與阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wind-tunnel testing cannot guarantee a finished bridge will never vibrate: actual damping, attachments, temporary fittings or the wind field may differ from the test. In May 2010 the Volgograd Bridge in Russia vibrated noticeably in strong wind; authorities closed it to all motor traffic on 20 May and reopened it on 25 May, and semi-active tuned mass dampers were then developed by MAURER with partners including the Swiss laboratory Empa, with 12 units of 5,200 kg each installed in autumn 2011. In-service remedies include added dampers, guide vanes or fairings and removal of attachments that alter the flow, but each must start from monitoring data that confirm the vibration pattern. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善：定量估算
steps.titleEn: In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「營運期渦振與阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：渦振振幅約與 Scruton 數成反比 y ∝ 1/Sc。若加裝阻尼器使對數衰減率由 0.02 提升到 0.08，Sc 增為 4 倍，振幅約降為 1/4，例如由 0.40 m 降為約 0.10 m；12 組 5,200 kg 阻尼器合計質量 62,400 kg。數值除阻尼器規格外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vortex amplitude varies roughly as 1/Sc. Raising the logarithmic decrement from 0.02 to 0.08 with dampers quadruples Sc and cuts amplitude to about a quarter, for example from 0.40 m to about 0.10 m; twelve 5,200 kg dampers total 62,400 kg. Values other than the damper data are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在跨中與四分點布設加速度計與現地風速計，記錄振動發生時的風速、風向、頻率與振型，確認是否落在渦振鎖定區；改善後以相同條件比較振幅，並以自由衰減或環境振動資料計算阻尼提升量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place accelerometers at midspan and quarter points with a site anemometer, recording wind speed, direction, frequency and mode shape during events to confirm whether they fall in a lock-in range; after the remedy compare amplitudes under the same conditions and compute the added damping from free decay or ambient data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「營運期風振觀測與改善」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies", which statement holds?
options: 只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。
渦振振幅約與 Scruton 數成反比 y ∝ 1/Sc。
結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。
optionsEn: If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it.
Vortex amplitude varies roughly as 1/Sc.
Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests.

steps.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「營運期渦振與阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在跨中與四分點布設加速度計與現地風速計，記錄振動發生時的風速、風向、頻率與振型，確認是否落在渦振鎖定區；改善後以相同條件比較振幅，並以自由衰減或環境振動資料計算阻尼提升量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place accelerometers at midspan and quarter points with a site anemometer, recording wind speed, direction, frequency and mode shape during events to confirm whether they fall in a lock-in range; after the remedy compare amplitudes under the same conditions and compute the added damping from free decay or ambient data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長跨橋梁的監測系統要能在風振事件時自動觸發高頻記錄並通知管理單位；任何改善方案須以監測資料與風洞或數值驗證為依據，並由原設計或獨立風工程師核定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Monitoring on long-span bridges should automatically trigger high-rate recording and notify the owner during wind-vibration events; any remedy must rest on monitoring data and wind-tunnel or numerical verification, approved by the original designer or an independent wind engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未先辨識振動模態就安裝阻尼器，阻尼器調到錯誤頻率而幾乎無效；或為了趕快恢復通車只加裝導流板而未經試驗，結果改變了扭轉氣動特性，反而降低顫振餘裕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Installing dampers before identifying the mode tunes them to the wrong frequency and makes them nearly useless; adding untested guide vanes to reopen quickly can change torsional aerodynamics and reduce the flutter margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「營運期渦振與阻尼器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未先辨識振動模態就安裝阻尼器，阻尼器調到錯誤頻率而幾乎無效；或為了趕快恢復通車只加裝導流板而未經試驗，結果改變了扭轉氣動特性，反而降低顫振餘裕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Installing dampers before identifying the mode tunes them to the wrong frequency and makes them nearly useless; adding untested guide vanes to reopen quickly can change torsional aerodynamics and reduce the flutter margin. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：營運期的改善手段包括加裝阻尼器、導流板或整流罩，以及移除改變氣流的附屬物，但每一項都要先以監測資料確認振動型態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In-service remedies include added dampers, guide vanes or fairings and removal of attachments that alter the flow, but each must start from monitoring data that confirm the vibration pattern.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Change control, closure wind speeds and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「附屬物變更的氣動複核」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋梁在數十年營運中會加裝防風牆、隔音牆、管線、照明、檢修車軌道或更換欄杆，這些都改變斷面外形與阻力，可能讓渦振重新出現或降低顫振風速。交接文件因此要保存風洞試驗的斷面幾何、試驗條件、靜力係數、顫振導數與允收結果，並規定任何外形變更都需氣動複核。營運面則要訂定依風速分級的交通管制，例如強風時限制高車身車輛或封橋，並把風速監測與管制程序連結。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「附屬物變更的氣動複核」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Over decades of service a bridge acquires wind screens, noise barriers, utilities, lighting, gantry rails or new railings, all of which change section shape and drag and can revive vortex shedding or lower flutter speed. Handover documents must therefore keep the tested section geometry, test conditions, static coefficients, flutter derivatives and acceptance results, and require aerodynamic review of any change in shape. Operationally, wind-speed-graded traffic control, such as restricting high-sided vehicles or closing the bridge in strong wind, must be defined and linked to wind monitoring. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每延公尺阻力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Drag per metre F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「附屬物變更的氣動複核」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Change control, closure wind speeds and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「附屬物變更的氣動複核」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每延公尺阻力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D。U = 60 m/s、D = 4 m：無防風牆 C_D = 1.0 時 F = 0.5×1.25×3,600×4×1.0 = 9.0 kN/m；加裝防風牆後 C_D = 1.6，F = 14.4 kN/m，1 km 橋長的總橫向風力由 9,000 kN 增為 14,400 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Drag per metre F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D. With U = 60 m/s and D = 4 m: without wind screens, C_D = 1.0 gives F = 0.5×1.25×3,600×4×1.0 = 9.0 kN/m; with screens C_D = 1.6 gives 14.4 kN/m, raising the total lateral load on 1 km of deck from 9,000 kN to 14,400 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：任何改裝申請都要附上新外形圖，由風工程師判斷是否需要補充節段模型試驗或數值模擬，比較靜力係數、渦振與顫振結果與原試驗；交通管制門檻以現地風速計資料與車輛側風穩定分析訂定，並定期檢討事件紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every modification request includes the new section drawing, and a wind engineer decides whether supplementary section tests or numerical simulation are needed to compare static coefficients, vortex and flutter results with the original tests; traffic-control thresholds come from site anemometer data and vehicle crosswind-stability analysis, with event records reviewed periodically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With U = 60 m/s and D = 4 m: without wind screens, C_D = 1.0 gives F = 0.5×1.25×3,600×4×1.0 = 9.0 kN/m; with screens C_D = 1.6 gives 14.4 kN/m, raising the total lateral load on 1 km of deck from 9,000 kN to 14,400 kN. steps.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Change control, closure wind speeds and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「附屬物變更的氣動複核」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 任何改裝申請都要附上新外形圖，由風工程師判斷是否需要補充節段模型試驗或數值模擬，比較靜力係數、渦振與顫振結果與原試驗；交通管制門檻以現地風速計資料與車輛側風穩定分析訂定，並定期檢討事件紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Every modification request includes the new section drawing, and a wind engineer decides whether supplementary section tests or numerical simulation are needed to compare static coefficients, vortex and flutter results with the original tests; traffic-control thresholds come from site anemometer data and vehicle crosswind-stability analysis, with event records reviewed periodically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含風場參數、節段與全橋試驗報告、靜力係數與顫振導數、完工實測頻率與阻尼、監測系統設定與依風速分級的交通管制程序；外形變更一律經風工程師核定後才可施作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover includes wind-field parameters, section and full-model test reports, static coefficients and flutter derivatives, measured as-built frequencies and damping, monitoring settings and wind-graded traffic-control procedures; any change of shape proceeds only after a wind engineer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：管理單位為了行車安全加裝實心防風牆，卻未做氣動複核，結果橋面阻力大增、渦振重新出現，甚至降低顫振餘裕；交接時沒有保存試驗斷面與數據，日後無法判斷改裝的影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An owner fits solid wind screens for road safety without aerodynamic review, sharply increasing drag, reviving vortex vibration and even reducing the flutter margin; without the tested section and data kept at handover, the effect of modifications cannot later be judged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Change control, closure wind speeds and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「附屬物變更的氣動複核」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 管理單位為了行車安全加裝實心防風牆，卻未做氣動複核，結果橋面阻力大增、渦振重新出現，甚至降低顫振餘裕；交接時沒有保存試驗斷面與數據，日後無法判斷改裝的影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An owner fits solid wind screens for road safety without aerodynamic review, sharply increasing drag, reviving vortex vibration and even reducing the flutter margin; without the tested section and data kept at handover, the effect of modifications cannot later be judged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：營運面則要訂定依風速分級的交通管制，例如強風時限制高車身車輛或封橋，並把風速監測與管制程序連結。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Operationally, wind-speed-graded traffic control, such as restricting high-sided vehicles or closing the bridge in strong wind, must be defined and linked to wind monitoring.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
